subject.title: Strict-agentic retry should allow terminal turns with only read-only inspection tools

question: Which open candidate PR should be treated as the canonical landing branch for this issue once it has real strict-agentic/Codex runtime proof?
rationale: Current main is still broken, but two open PRs overlap the same root cause and both have proof or compatibility review context that a maintainer should reconcile before merge.

options.title: Use the newer focused candidate after proof
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102106 as the likely canonical path if it adds the requested redacted runtime proof and remains free of review findings.

options.title: Use the earlier broader candidate if repaired
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101905 as canonical only if its public SDK surface concern is resolved and it adds real behavior proof.

options.title: Pause both and request a maintainer patch
options.body: If neither contributor branch is acceptable, keep this issue open and ask for a maintainer-owned narrow patch that preserves the same fail-closed safety boundary.

recommendation.title: Use the newer focused candidate after proof
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102106 as the likely canonical path if it adds the requested redacted runtime proof and remains free of review findings.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is assigned on the newer live candidate PR and has recent history on the affected tool-mutation helper surface.
